Extend Forma's public contract for seven presentation gaps Chrona found (application sidebar and tab bar, large surface radius, display title scale, inverse hero surface, time-column timeline, filled primary action and control radius, skip link without marketing tokens)
items.description: From Chrona's legacy look-and-feel inventory (kemiller2002/chrona docs/legacy/look-and-feel-inventory.md section 7, WI-0042). Forma 0.4.1 cannot express these through its Brand Manifest or components, so Chrona composes chrona-* classes on --ef-* tokens in web/chrona.css until Forma extends its contract deliberately. G1 a dark persistent application sidebar and a mobile bottom tab bar with marks; G2 a large surface radius token (legacy 1.35rem); G3 a display title scale for page titles (up to 4.4rem); G4 an inverse hero surface for a running timer with light-on-dark actions; G5 a time-column timeline (times, marker, rule) for ledgers; G6 a filled primary action and a control radius token for buttons and inputs (buttons and inputs are radius-none today); G7 .ef-skip-link positions itself with marketing spacing tokens (--ef-space-2) that an application page does not load, so on such a page it renders in flow instead of off-screen.

items.title: Codemod test build helper: stale-lock edge cases
items.description: tests/support/migrator.mjs: a lock left by a killed run stalls later runs for up to 10 minutes; a build folder without its DLL fails forever with ENOTEMPTY on rename (remove it and rebuild); two waiters can both remove a stale lock. Does not affect CI (fresh runners). Recorded from the #185 review.
